column1: # Known upward dependencies of the single-package stage (#440), one per line:
# kind, file, target module, separated by tabs. No line numbers, so edits to a
# file do not churn this list.
# This list may only shrink. A dependency that is not here fails `layering`; a
# line that no longer matches a dependency fails as stale. Fix the design
# (move the item down or invert the dependency), never extend the list.
# Owners: the core and theme rows are removed by #441, the ui and widgets rows
# and the ui::layers test rows by #442, and the two test_alloc rows by #449.
